question: Excluding the non-recurring IEEPA tariff refund benefit, what was Costco's Q4 FY2026 diluted EPS, and what was the YoY growth on that basis vs Q4 FY2025?
grading: Adjusted EPS ±$0.01; growth ±0.5pp; must use the per-share benefit as disclosed by Costco and 16-week Q4 columns
answer: Costco Q4 FY2026 diluted EPS excluding the disclosed net tariff-refund benefit was $6.60 ($6.75 - $0.15), up 12.4361% from Q4 FY2025 EPS of $5.87. Both quarters contained 16 weeks. The $0.15 benefit is already net of partial reinvestment in member values. [G15-E1]

output.answer:
**Question:** Excluding the non-recurring IEEPA tariff refund benefit, what was Costco's Q4 FY2026 diluted EPS, and what was the YoY growth on that basis vs Q4 FY2025?
*As of 2026-10-01*

| | Diluted EPS excluding IEEPA tariff refund benefit (USD) | YoY diluted EPS growth excluding IEEPA benefit (%) |
|---|---|---|
| Q4 FY2026 (16 weeks ended August 30, 2026) | 6.60 [1][2] | — |
| Q4 FY2026 vs Q4 FY2025 (16 weeks ended August 30, 2026 vs August 31, 2025) | — | 12.4 [1][2][3] |

- Costco reported Q4 FY2026 (16 weeks ended August 30, 2026) net income of $2.998 billion and diluted EPS of $6.75, on a GAAP as-reported basis. [1][4]
- Costco stated that Q4 FY2026 was positively impacted by a non-recurring benefit of $0.15 per diluted share from IEEPA tariff refunds received in the quarter, less partial reinvestment of those refunds in increased member values. [1][2]
- Excluding the non-recurring IEEPA tariff refund benefit, Q4 FY2026 diluted EPS was 6.60 (GAAP as-reported $6.75 less the $0.15 per-share benefit). [1][2]
- Costco disclosed that, excluding the non-recurring IEEPA tariff refund benefit, Q4 FY2026 EPS grew 12.4% (and net income grew 12.3%) versus Q4 FY2025. [2][5]
- Q4 FY2025 (16 weeks ended August 31, 2025) diluted EPS was $5.87, the prior-year comparison base for the ex-benefit growth rate. [3]
- Calculated on the same ex-benefit basis, Q4 FY2026 diluted EPS of $6.60 versus Q4 FY2025 diluted EPS of $5.87 implies YoY growth of 12.4%, consistent with the 12.4% the company disclosed. [1][2][3]

**Not available**
- An explicitly labeled 'adjusted/ex-benefit diluted EPS' line item in Costco's Q4 FY2026 financial statements: The release and supplemental deck disclose the $0.15 per-share benefit and the resulting 12.4% EPS growth rate, but do not present a separate ex-benefit EPS line in the income statement; the $6.60 figure is derived by subtracting the disclosed $0.15 benefit from reported $6.75. [1][2]
- Q4 FY2026 10-K note-level detail (segment/note disclosures, full financial statements): Only the Q4 FY2026 earnings release (8-K EX-99.1/99.2, filed 2026-09-24) is available; the FY2026 10-K has not been filed as of 2026-10-01. [1][2]

**Sources**
[1] COSTCO WHOLESALE CORP /NEW earnings release for Q4 FY2026, 8-K EX-99.1 (filed 2026-09-24) (www.sec.gov, 2026-09-24, primary) https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/909832/000090983226000084/costex9918-k92426.htm
[2] COSTCO WHOLESALE CORP /NEW earnings release for Q4 FY2026, 8-K EX-99.2 (filed 2026-09-24) (www.sec.gov, 2026-09-24, primary) https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/909832/000090983226000084/costex9928-k92426.htm
[3] COSTCO WHOLESALE CORP /NEW earnings release for Q4 FY2025, 8-K EX-99.1 (filed 2025-09-25) (www.sec.gov, 2025-09-25, primary) https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/909832/000090983225000093/costex9918-k92525.htm
[4] Costco Wholesale Corporation - Costco Wholesale Corporation Reports Fourth Quarter and Fiscal Year 2026 Operating Results (investor.costco.com, 2026-09-24, primary) https://investor.costco.com/news/news-details/2026/Costco-Wholesale-Corporation-Reports-Fourth-Quarter-and-Fiscal-Year-2026-Operating-Results/default.aspx
